title: Ind-etale base change for qcqs ordinary etale derived direct image
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, and use sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A$ on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $u:S'\to S$ be affine and locally ind-etale: on affine charts its ring maps are filtered colimits of etale algebras of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Set $X'=X\times_SS'$ with projections $v:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. On bounded-below ordinary derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use exact inverse images $u^*,v^*$ and right derived direct images $Rf_*,Rf'_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ the canonical module-linear exchange morphism
$$u^*Rf_*K\longrightarrow Rf'_*v^*K$$
is an isomorphism in $D^+(S'_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Here canonical exchange means the adjunction mate of $f'^*u^*Rf_*K\cong v^*f^*Rf_*K\to v^*K$, the last arrow being the pulled-back ordinary counit [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange, lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients]. No constructibility, Noetherian, finite-type, or coefficient-invertibility hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Transport the common-universe ind-etale predicate back along the two ULift ring isomorphisms. The ind-etale morphism property respects isomorphisms. On each affine chart use proAffineEtale_iff_appTop to obtain exactly the hypothesis of indEtale_strictLocal_invariance. At any geometric point x of S′ this gives a pointed isomorphism e:S′_(x) -> S_(gx). Its Spec.preimage a has Spec.map a=e.hom, and faithfulness of Spec identifies the evaluation equation with the ring equation required by the stalk comparison.

proof.text: For an arbitrary Cartesian square, use the argument of the strict-local stalk criterion in a private helper, retaining the actual square rather than its reversed chosen pullback. Give the strict henselization rings their local structures, identify the small and canonical strict localizations via smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso_toBase, and factor the geometric points through their residue fields using strictHenselizationClosedLift_over. Apply exists_addEquiv_strictHenselization_abelian_stalkExchange and exists_addEquiv_strictLocal_abelian_total_exchange. Their two equations conjugate the degree-q exchange stalk to cohomology pullback on the strict-local fibre products.

The map between strict-local fibre products is pullback.map of the isomorphism Spec.map a and two identities, hence is invertible. Cohomology pullback along an isomorphism is bijective by the proved topological-invariance theorem. The private stalk criterion makes the original exchange stalk invertible. Transfer to universe-lifted stalks through uliftSheafFiberIso and apply the conservative geometric-point family. This proves degree-q exchange for every abelian sheaf and q>=0, with no torsion condition.

source.place: Tags 0EZU, 03PU and 03SI (only the isomorphism special case)

proof.text: Exact inverse image preserves every lower cohomology bound, using mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso. Right derived direct image also preserves every lower bound by isZero_homologyFunctor_rightDerivedFunctorPlus_obj_of_isGE. Thus both exchange functors preserve every lower bound. On a sheaf in degree zero both sides have zero negative cohomology; the unique morphism between zero objects is invertible. Together with Step 3, cohomology detection proves exchange on every sheaf in degree zero.

Use the existing shift compatibility and triangulated structures of the derived exchange and its two functors. Apply heart_test_bounded_below to each bounded-below abelian complex, using Step 4 for both lower-bound hypotheses and for exchange on its cohomology sheaves in degree zero. This is finite Postnikov induction followed by truncation, and needs neither preservation of injectives by inverse image nor an underived degree-zero exchange comparison. Finally apply the concluding equivalence of exchange_forget_coefficients to the chosen fibre-product square and the given module-valued complex K.
